outputs.explanation: The spatial plots show cell-deconvolution scores per spatial spot as a heatmap over the tissue section; they are not summary/average plots (e.g., bar or box plots) that aggregate replicates, so individual data points are not applicable here.

The box plots quantifying fraction of cells for each immune population display the individual data points (jittered dots for each spatial spot) overlaid on the box, in addition to the box summary statistics.
GSEA enrichment plots show the running enrichment score across the ranked gene list, not an averaged summary statistic across replicates, so individual data points are not applicable.

The bar graph shows log2 fold-change values from a differential gene expression analysis for each gene, a single computed statistic per gene from the bioinformatic comparison rather than a mean over discrete biological replicates, so individual data points are not expected/applicable.
This panel consists of representative H&E and IHC micrographs, not a quantitative plot showing averaged values, so individual data points do not apply.
